bio: On the first floor of the culture and congress centre, Forum am Schlosspark, an interesting restaurant and wine bar concept awaits you. The cuisine is modern, seasonal and international, but also has classical influences; dishes can be ordered as a set menu or à la carte. Good wines, friendly, attentive service and a chic, light and airy space. The terrace with a view over Kastanienallee is delightful. If you are coming by car, you can park on the Bärenwiese opposite....
